review_basis: Downloaded and hashed all 30 City PDFs in the collection.
Compared normalized extracted text, project totals, and the rendered October 2010 citywide summary against the validated December 2010/2011 GO Bond schedule archive.

Scope sheets are distinct project-purpose records; versioned schedules with different totals are retained separately; substantively identical schedules are consolidated to their existing canonical records.

approved_for_addition.title: 2011-2020 General Obligation Bond Program Summary (October 2010 Edition)
approved_for_addition.description: Provides the October 2010 citywide general-obligation-bond totals, showing planned 2011 through 2019 allocations for streets, drainage, parks, public safety, transit, community facilities, affordable housing, neighborhood set-asides, public art, and energy programs.

approved_for_addition.title: 2011 Animal Welfare General Obligation Bond Project Scope
approved_for_addition.description: Defines the 2011 $1.2 million Animal Welfare bond project for shelter rehabilitation, equipment, vehicles, mobile adoption, and off-site adoption operations.

approved_for_addition.title: 2011 City Facilities and Parking General Obligation Bond Project Scope
approved_for_addition.description: Defines $2.5 million in 2011 bond scopes for Municipal Development vehicles, City-building rehabilitation, Plaza del Sol stucco, security systems, roof and plumbing repairs, and parking-facility upgrades.

approved_for_addition.title: 2011 Cultural Services General Obligation Bond Project Scope
approved_for_addition.description: Defines $9.475 million in 2011 Cultural Services bond projects for BioPark exhibits, the South Broadway Cultural Center, a BioPark-Old Town connection, library materials and automation, and Albuquerque Museum history exhibits.

approved_for_addition.title: 2011 Environmental Health General Obligation Bond Project Scope
approved_for_addition.description: Defines $1.52 million in 2011 Environmental Health bond projects for Los Angeles Landfill remediation, environmental monitoring equipment, and connecting Montessa Park facilities to the municipal water system.

approved_for_addition.title: 2011 Family and Community Services General Obligation Bond Project Scope
approved_for_addition.description: Defines $8.8 million in 2011 Family and Community Services bond projects for facility improvements, Los Duranes, Westgate, Holiday Park, East Central, and Dennis Chavez community centers, youth cultural facilities, and vehicles.

approved_for_addition.title: 2011 Finance and Administrative Services General Obligation Bond Project Scope
approved_for_addition.description: Defines $12.175 million in 2011 Finance and Administrative Services bond projects for enterprise systems, servers, public-safety radio management, network infrastructure, content management, computer rooms, and business-continuity planning.

approved_for_addition.title: 2011 Fire General Obligation Bond Project Scope
approved_for_addition.description: Defines the 2011 $4.625 million Fire bond program for replacing emergency-response apparatus, including engines, ladder trucks, Hazmat rescue vehicles, brush trucks, and rehabilitating fire stations.

approved_for_addition.title: 2011 Parks and Recreation General Obligation Bond Project Scope
approved_for_addition.description: Defines $14.65 million in 2011 Parks and Recreation bond projects for parks, pools, trails, open space, Bosque restoration, Balloon Fiesta Park, forestry, neighborhood and community parks, and vehicle equipment.

approved_for_addition.title: 2011 Planning General Obligation Bond Project Scope
approved_for_addition.description: Defines $3 million in 2011 Planning bond projects for community planning, electronic plan review, GIS and KIVA systems, North Fourth Street, DeAnza, Clayton Heights, East Gateway, and New York redevelopment areas.

approved_for_addition.title: 2011 Police General Obligation Bond Project Scope
approved_for_addition.description: Defines the 2011 $5.475 million Police bond projects for marked and unmarked vehicle replacement, APD facility repair, and the Comprehensive Information Systems Project.

approved_for_addition.title: 2011 Senior Affairs General Obligation Bond Project Scope
approved_for_addition.description: Defines the 2011 $1 million Senior Affairs bond project for rehabilitation and equipment at senior centers, fitness centers, and other senior-program facilities.

approved_for_addition.title: 2011 Storm Drainage General Obligation Bond Project Scope
approved_for_addition.description: Defines $12.95 million in 2011 storm-drainage bond projects for water quality, pump stations, arroyo crossings, Alameda Riverside Drains, Volcano Cliffs, San Pedro, hydrology, and neighborhood flood-control improvements.

approved_for_addition.title: 2011 Streets General Obligation Bond Project Scope
approved_for_addition.description: Defines $39.6 million in 2011 Streets bond projects for road and intersection reconstruction, paving, traffic management, bridges, sidewalks, safety, trails, bikeways, lighting, and named Albuquerque corridor improvements.

approved_for_addition.title: 2011 Transit General Obligation Bond Project Scope
approved_for_addition.description: Defines the 2011 $6.2 million transit bond projects for revenue and support vehicles, park-and-ride facilities, transit technology, facility rehabilitation, maintenance equipment, and bus-stop improvements.

approved_for_addition.description: Records the October 2010 Finance and Administrative Services schedule, totaling $25.015 million through 2019 for enterprise systems, servers, radio management, network infrastructure, records management, computer rooms, and continuity planning.
